$comment: Every test suite this repository has, and whether a pull request's CI runs it. scripts/test-coverage.mjs fails CI when a package.json script, a directory under tests/ or a test config is missing from this file, and posts the suites marked notOnPr on every pull request, so a green check never claims a suite it did not run.

pnpm exec tsc --noEmit.what: The frontend typechecks. tsconfig.json includes src only, so nothing under tests/ or scripts/ is covered (AGENTS.md, 'the other hand-maintained ports').
pnpm exec tsc --noEmit.notAScript: CI typechecks without building. The `build` script is `tsc && vite build`, and the vite build runs only inside the installer.

test.what: The data-layer workflow harness: the real migrations loaded into in-memory SQLite, the lab-pipeline invariants, and a gate per GitHub issue.

test:legacy.what: A real populated pre-0023 database, taken up both upgrade paths.

test:ui.what: Component and render tests under jsdom. vitest.config.ts includes src/**/*.test.{ts,tsx} only.

test:e2e.what: The real app in Chromium against the sql.js Tauri shim: read-only gating, drawer state, filters, the request dialog, everything above the data layer.

test:compat.what: The release in use and this tree, each opening, working on, reverting and syncing the other's database (docs/release_compat.md).

test:release.what: The release checks' own tests, and that this tree's five version sources agree. The same workflow also runs `release-check.mjs provenance`, which is a check on the repository rather than a suite.

test:suites.what: This file checked against the tree and the workflows, and the checker's own tests.

cargo test --lib --locked.what: The Rust shell, and in it db_migrate_image (src-tauri/src/migrate.rs), which the TypeScript model in src/test/sqlx-migrator.ts only stands in for. The same job runs `cargo check --locked` first, which is what catches a version bumped in Cargo.toml and not in Cargo.lock.
cargo test --lib --locked.notAScript: The Rust shell is built by cargo, not by pnpm; the job runs it in src-tauri.

test:staining.what: The staining-stack model agreed for 0.3.3: cross-sample racks, substage advance as a unit, scatter on leaving staining.
test:staining.notOnPr: It is self-contained by design (scripts/staining-stack-harness.mjs): it builds its own tables and its own reference implementation, so it asserts nothing about this tree's migrations or src/lib/db.ts and cannot go red on a change to them.

test:stress.what: The v1 stress walk: hand-written paths that fill the database up, with retries off and console errors fatal.
test:stress.notOnPr: It is slow and fills the database up rather than proving one behaviour, so playwright.stress.config.ts keeps it out of the path that gates every push. Superseded in method by test:stress2 and test:stress3.

test:stress2.what: Scale and invariants: a seeded random walk of thousands of data-layer actions, fuzzed interleavings, sentinel values, and an invariant set derived from defects that were real.
test:stress2.notOnPr: It has never been wired into any CI job. It is minutes long, and AGENTS.md asks for it to be run locally on a schema or workflow change. Recorded here rather than left silent: this is the suite whose absence from CI went unnoticed until a pull request author happened to write it down by hand.

test:stress3.what: The explorer: the walk of v2 driven through the real UI, with each surface compared against a count recomputed from the store, plus Undo and Redo (docs/stress_test_v3.md).
test:stress3.notOnPr: It has never been wired into any CI job. It drives the browser for minutes, and AGENTS.md asks for it to be run locally on a schema or workflow change.

playwright test --config playwright.show.what: The tutorial and screenshot walkthrough: it photographs the app's screens for a person to look at.
playwright test --config playwright.show.notAScript: It has no package.json script; the config's own header says to run it with `npx playwright test --config playwright.showcase.config.ts`.
playwright test --config playwright.show.notOnPr: It is kept out of the main suite on purpose so it never gates a release, and it takes screenshots rather than asserting behaviour.

otherScripts.dev: The Vite dev server against the Tauri shell.
otherScripts.dev:browser: The Vite dev server with the sql.js Tauri shim, which every Playwright suite serves.
otherScripts.build: tsc && vite build. CI typechecks with `tsc --noEmit`; the vite build itself runs only inside the installer build, as tauri.conf.json's beforeBuildCommand.
otherScripts.test:e2e:headed: The end-to-end suite with a visible browser, for local work.
otherScripts.test:e2e:ui: The end-to-end suite in Playwright's UI mode, for local work.

otherPaths.tests/fixtures: Recorded databases the suites read; tests/fixtures/legacy-pre-0023.b64 is test:legacy's input.
otherPaths.tests/helpers: Page helpers shared by the Playwright suites.
